text:
rajesh: Need a new GPU node pool in europe-north1 for low-latency inference serving (prod). Target shape: ~12 GPUs initially, scale up to ~48 during peak. Latency SLOs p95 50-80ms. Prefer A10G nodes for perf, but L4s look cheaper — thoughts?

sophia: A10G sounds right for latency. Heads up: our current a10g quota in europe-north1 is 24 total, only ~6 free. You need a quota bump request to GCP. Also +1 on 1 GPU-per-node for predictable latency.

maria: Agree on 1 GPU/node. Suggest mixed nodepools: reserved (dedicated) pool for warm workers + preemptible burst pool. For autoscaler, use these flags: 
```
--balance-similar-node-groups=true 
--expander=least-waste 
--scale-down-delay=10m 
--max-empty-bulk-delete=10 
```
And set nodeGroup min/max: reserved min=3 max=24, burst min=0 max=24.

infra-bot: quota-check: region=europe-north1, gpu_type=a10g, quota_total=24, allocated=18, available=6. h100 not available in region. NAT external IPs remaining=2.

dave: Network caveat: current NAT gateway has only 2 external IPs for egress. If we scale node count to ~48, we'll run out of ephemeral egress IPs (pods talking to external inference validators, metrics, etc.). Recommend provision additional NAT IPs or a regional NAT gateway with auto-scaling. Also check route table and IP masquerade rules.

mike: Cost tradeoff: preemptible a10g reduces cost ~55-65% but eviction spikes can hurt p95. For strict 50ms SLO you probably want a baseline of reserved nodes (small) + preemptible for scale. Also consider using L4s for non-critical embedding/replica workloads to save $$ and keep A10G for hot paths.

julie: Driver/AMI note: use our gpu-ubuntu-22-09 image that contains nvidia-dkms + cuda13 runtime. A10G doesn't support MIG slicing reliably; can't split into smaller instances. Validate kernel headers in the image; we saw one cluster had a mismatch (kubelet failed after upgrade).

sophia: I'll open the GCP quota request now and create an infra ticket to add NAT IPs. Proposed nodepool config: 
- name: gpu-a10g-reserved
- nodeTemplate: n2-standard-16 (or equivalent), 1 x a10g, 120Gi root disk
- taint: gpu=true:NoSchedule
- labels: gpu_type=a10g, workload=inference
- autoscaler: min=3 max=48 (split reserved/burst as above)

I'll also draft a Terraform change for the nodepool + NAT. CC @maria for autoscaler options. :thumbsup:

maria: I'll review the autoscaler PR — also recommend pod-disruption-budgets for critical services (minAvailable 2) and startupProbe to avoid premature scale-down.

rajesh: Thanks. Assigning tasks: @sophia -> quota + NAT, @maria -> autoscaler config + PDBs, @julie -> AMI driver validation. I'll open a short RFC for node sizing and cost comparison. Going to create the infra ticket and a Terraform PR now.

sophia: Ticket created: INFRA-4271 (quota + nat). PR draft: terraform:gpu-eunorth1-nodepool WIP.

rajesh: Perfect — keeping this thread for cross-checks. Will post PR link once ready. :rocket:
